item.title: Durban Open puts Dolphin Coast in global golf spotlight
item.description: Durban will once again welcome world-class international golf to its fairways.

item.title: Ballesteros statue goes missing
item.description: A life-sized statue of Spanish golf great Seve Ballesteros has gone missing from his hometown Pedrena, in the north of the country in an apparent robbery.

item.title: Three share Big Easy lead at Ebotse
item.description: America’s Austin Cherichella played himself into a three-way share of the lead in Tuesday’s opening round of the 10th Betway Big Easy Tour event of the season.

item.title: Daffue excited to be back on Sunshine Tour fairways
item.description: MJ Daffue is back in South Africa to tee it up in this week’s Cell C Challenge in Honour of Gary Player at Killarney Country Club.

item.title: Varner joins Smash GC for 2026 LIV Golf season
item.description: Smash GC of the LIV Golf League has announced its roster for the 2026 season with the addition of Harold Varner III.

item.title: PXG backs Potgieter power
item.description: South African power hitter Aldrich Potgieter has signed with PXG as the American brand continues to expand its presence on the PGA Tour.

item.title: Liebenberg goes low to tie Big Easy lead
item.description: Louis Liebenberg carded a blemish-free six-under 66 in the second round of the 10th Betway Big Easy Tour event.

item.title: SA’s Ritchie chases Molinari at Dubai Desert Classic
item.description: Francesco Molinari powered into a two-shot lead after the first day of the Dubai Desert Classic on Thursday.

item.title: Porteous, Snyders share Cell C Challenge lead
item.description: Haydn Porteous and Tyran Snyders carded 64s to share the lead in the first round of the Cell C Challenge at Killarney Country Club on Thursday.

item.title: Scheffler tied for second in La Quinta
item.description: World No 1 Scottie Scheffler made a bright start to 2026 to join a big group one off the lead at the PGA Tour's American Express in La Quinta, California.
